summary: A fairytale island church on an alpine lake, framed by the Julian Alps — one of Europe's most photogenic destinations.

photography.goldenHourNotes: Bled's most iconic viewpoint (Mala Osojnica) faces east-southeast, making it perfect for sunrise. The lake is mirror-calm before 7 AM in summer. Autumn fog fills the valley at dawn, lifting by 9 AM to reveal the snow-capped Alps — a photographers' dream.

weather.seasonality: Summer (Jun–Aug) is warm and great for water activities. Autumn (Sep–Oct) has atmospheric fog and gorgeous foliage. Winter (Dec–Feb) brings snow and the lake sometimes freezes — magical for photographers.
weather.summary: Alpine climate with four distinct seasons. Summer is warm, winters are cold with potential snow. Rain falls year-round.
